anya: Dropping a quick prototype screenshot + notes — compact notify list iteration. main concerns: suppression discoverability, SR announce order, and compact preview behavior. screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/notify-compact-iter2.png mike: Visual nit: the severity chip color on light bg is borderline AA at 12px. Either darken the chip text or add a subtle 1px stroke. leah: For accessibility, the suppression indicator should be announced as a state phrase: "notifications suppressed" instead of a lone word badge. keeps meaning clear. jordan: About announce order: some users prefer context-first (channel then severity) and others want severity-first. Suggest A/B voice tests but default to severity-first for quicker triage. ben: Copy nit: when announcing counts, say "2 recent messages" not "2 previews". clearer for SR listeners. anya: UX decision: hide full message previews in compact rows by default; show an ellipsized snippet only if there's room, and provide a keyboard-accessible toggle to expand inline. mike: For keyboard order, I suggest menu first then preview toggle. reduces accidental expansion while scanning. leah: That breaks LTR semantics. Keep inline controls left-to-right: preview toggle before overflow menu, but make menu focusable with a 0ms response handler so SR users don't perceive lag. ux-bot: Accessibility snippet suggestion: ```html
Critical Database Alerts
``` leah: Note: put aria-live on the preview container only, not the whole row, to avoid redundant speech on focus. ben: Microcopy: overflow menu item "Snooze" -> change to "Snooze notifications" and show duration hint like "(1h)" in the preview state. anya: I'll update Figma and add these as acceptance criteria: severity-first announce, suppression as verb phrase, preview announced via aria-live on expand, preview toggle focusable with clear aria-expanded, menu focus order confirmed. tagging @jordan @ben for pairing next week. ux-bot: Prototype pushed: /figma/NotifyRow/compact-iter2 (build id: 2026-03-22-02). jordan: I'll pair on Thursday for SR tests. please add the usability script to INF-1400. anya: Added acceptance criteria and script to INF-1400. thanks team!
